'''Orrays''' were leathery-skinned [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] quadrupeds native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Orray-CVD.png|thumb|left|200px|An orray fitted with a saddle.]]
The orray had great strength and a quick gait. To be tamed, these creatures had to have their stinger-tipped tails removed and, much like castration, this also served to make the orrays more docile. Wild orrays were known to feast on the [[Larva/Legends|larvae]] of [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] young, devouring thousands in a single meal. The orrays used their long snouts to root inside the sensitive egg chambers of Geonosian hives. As a holdover from that time, the orray's teeth are blunt to crush hard objects such as the eggshells.<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Alien Species" />

==History==
[[File:GeonosianRider-FFp78.png|thumb|right|200px|A Geonosian Picador on an orray mount.]]
Orrays were used as mounts for [[Picador/Legends|Geonosian Picadors]] on Geonosis. Several were ridden in the [[Petranaki arena]] during executions involving beasts such as [[Reek/Legends|reeks]], [[Nexu/Legends|nexus]], and [[Acklay/Legends|acklays]]. During the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were occasionally [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|ridden by]] [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|super battle droids]] armed with flamethrowers.
